The Process & Milestones

Little milestones. Big meaning.

I may not have achieved everything I dream about yet, but every step I've taken has taught me something worth keeping.

01 Ongoing

Mechanical Engineering

Pursuing Mechanical Engineering, exploring foundational mechanical systems, production design, mechanics of materials, and methodical real-world problem-solving.

Discipline & Academics
02 Prototype Phase

Pick-and-Place Robotic Arm

Designed and simulated a multi-axis pick-and-place manipulator focused on inverse kinematics, torque calculations, actuator selection, and physical fabrication.

Robotics & Automation
03 National Stage

Smart India Hackathon

Collaborated on an intensive 36-hour sprint engineering a disaster-response payload drone concept designed for inaccessible rural terrains during flash emergencies.

Innovation & Rapid Prototyping
04 Technical Skill

CAD & Generative Modeling

Proficient in parametric 3D modeling, GD&T tolerancing, assembly drafting in AutoCAD & SolidWorks, translating complex mental schemas into machinable drawings.

Design & 3D Drafting
05 Certified

Technical Workshops & LabVIEW

Immersed in advanced hands-on workshops including LabVIEW graphical programming for hardware data acquisition, sensor calibration, and instrumentation telemetry.

Instrumentation & Measurement
06 Community

Student Leadership & Events

Spearheading engineering department symposiums and collegiate technical clubs. Honing interpersonal coordination, resource planning, and empathetic leadership.

Coordination & Teamwork

Every accomplishment starts with the decision to try.
